name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Operations & Systems | CRM Administration, Zapier Automation, Process Documentation & Training
summary: Client operations and systems builder who looks at how a small team actually works, finds where time leaks out, and fixes it with clean processes, a well-kept CRM, and automation. Has built 20+ automated workflows and Zapier automations since 2018, administered CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel), and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 on documented processes so new people got the same result as experienced ones. Learns new software fast, works fully remote, and keeps records organized enough to hold up to review.

experience.title: Client Operations & Systems (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Map how small service businesses run day to day, then redesign the workflow with CRM structure and automation so owners spend less time on admin and more with clients.
Administer client CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel) with clear segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene rules, keeping every client, prospect, and past-client record current.
Built 20+ automated workflows across intake, booking, reminders, onboarding, and follow-up, connecting tools through Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Document every interaction, timeline, and deliverable in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion so records stay auditable, and build reusable templates so each new engagement starts from a proven base.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94%), and built automated training sequences that cut onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors, and served a banking-industry client.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Trained onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions, 1:1 coaching, and workshops, so new specialists could run the process the same way experienced ones did.
Defined the CRM fields required for onboarding and sales workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and implemented a client-work management platform (CRM, projects, billing) for professional-services firms, and built Zapier automations for clients.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
